result.title: FedUDG: Federated Domain Generalization with Unlabeled Clients
result.summary: Federated domain generalization (FDG) aims to learn models that generalize reliably to out-of-distribution (OOD) environments without centralizing client's data. However, existing FDG methods assume that all source clients have labeled data, limiting their ability to leverage the abundant unlabeled client data available in practice. To address this limitation, we propose FedUDG. At the federation level, FedUDG utilizes a parameter-functional differentiation strategy that maintains a semantic anchor updated solely using ground-truth labels. The remaining parameters absorb knowledge from unlabeled domains under bounded aggregation, preventing domain-biased noise from eroding the class semantics. Within each unlabeled client, FedUDG utilizes a student-teacher framework with two complementary objectives: (1) semantic self-training on high-confidence samples, using the functional differentiation between the semantic anchor and classifier to constrain the model to learn semantically pure and cross-domain stable features; and (2) label-free representation distillation on all unlabeled samples to stabilize learning under appearance variations. Together, these objectives guide the model toward a transferable feature space, while mitigating overfitting to domain-specific characteristics. Furthermore, to address the lack of systematic evaluation of FDG under formal privacy constraints, we develop a sample-level differentially private extension, DP-FedUDG, to quantify the trade-off between privacy and OOD generalization. Across four evaluation protocols, FedUDG consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. The code is available at https://github.com/Jr10426/FedUDG

AI.brief_summary: FedUDG 研究联邦域泛化中客户端数据无标签的情形，用参数功能分化保留语义锚、并在各客户端内以学生-教师自训练与无标签表示蒸馏稳定特征学习，另给出差分隐私扩展。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文关注联邦学习的隐私约束与跨域泛化，不涉及多模态推理状态、证据获取或停止决策，其中的语义锚与蒸馏机制也未指向 latent 推理，缺少可供核查的具体借鉴线索。
